description: This file defines the AutoFit class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for managing auto-fit functionalities related to worksheet auto-filters and table filtering in spreadsheets.

classes.name: AutoFit
classes.description: Provides methods to handle auto-filter related auto-fit operations on worksheet columns, including retrieving auto-filter ranges with appropriate indent ranges.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AutoFit object with a specific Worksheet instance.

methods.name: getAutoFilterIndentRanges
methods.description: Retrieves all relevant auto-filter indent ranges for the worksheet, including auto-filter and table filters.

methods.name: getAutoFilterIndentRange
methods.description: Determines the indent range for a given AutoFilter, returning a string representation if applicable.
